symptom: `alter page … { set (Attribute: Note) on dgOrders column(Number) }` refused for every spelling — "column property \"Attribute\" holds a value of kind Attribute, which ALTER cannot set from a plain value" — and `Attribute: Assoc/Attr` was a parse error; replacing the column was the only route, and it drops column properties the replacement does not restate (ako/mxcli#1644)
cause: setColumnPropertyMut wrote only plain-value kinds, nothing bound the column's attribute against the grid's data source, and alterPageAssignment parsed `A/B` as a division expression
file: mdl/executor/alter_set_column_attribute.go (resolveColumnAttribute), mdl/executor/cmd_alter_page.go (IsColumn Attribute branch; attribute applied last in applySetPropertyMutator), mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go (setColumnAttributeBinding), mdl/backend/mutation.go (AttributeBinding.Steps), mdl/grammar/MDLParser.g4 + visitor_alter_page.go (ATTRIBUTE: hop/path); tests alter_set_column_attribute_pedapp_test.go
insight: A SET that changes the property an element is ADDRESSED by breaks every later step that re-finds it by the address as written — here the hidden-property reset after a column SET (#1519), which failed with "column(Old) not found" once the attribute moved. Apply the address-changing property last. PedApp's Data grid 2 package ships no editorConfig, so the reset never ran there and the PedApp test passed against the bug; the 11.14 measurement found it, and the regression test installs the expr-checker fixture's package to reach it (control: without the ordering it fails with the measured error). Binding mirrors #1641: the executor resolves against EnclosingEntityForChildren(grid) with misbound/foreign-qualified refusals, the mutator writes AttributeRef + EntityRef steps as CREATE writes a multi-hop column.
